title: The Last Noob: They Left the Noob Outside

lines.text: Night one on the Pinewood server. The pros built a cabin, and voted the new guy out.
No noobs. You'll get us caught.
lines.speaker: pro

lines.text: So Noob waits by the gate, with nothing but a starter lantern.
Then the trees start to creak. Something huge walks out of the fog.
Everyone inside presses against the window to watch it.
But wait. The moon is right behind it, and it casts no shadow.
Noob looks back at the cabin. On the wall, one player's shadow is moving on its own.
You see, the thing outside was never the hunter. It was bait, to keep everyone staring out the window.
The real one was already sitting by the fire.
Noob doesn't run. He lifts his lantern and flashes it through the glass.
The light hits the fake player, and its disguise flickers away.
Noob kicks open the back door. Everybody out!
They sprint through the gate, as the shadow melts in the sunrise.
He smiles. But on the grass behind him, there are two shadows.
